The Hydraulic Power Pack (HPU) maintenance access panel is secured by four quarter-turn fasteners. Remove
the panel only after the unit has been shut down per Section 4 and pressure has been bled per Section 8. Do
not operate the unit with the panel removed.

threshold correction), and the Component Register (AEG-CR-700) should be consulted alongside this manual,
as component identifiers and setpoints have changed across software revisions.

conflicts.justification: Authoritative Engineering Change Notice ECN-1042 and Operator Manual AEG-OM-700 Rev 4 establish that normal HPU discharge operating pressure was revised from 180 bar to 200 bar effective Software Revision 3.2 (released 2025-09-30) alongside sensor upgrade to PS-04A to improve cycle time. The 180 bar value remains applicable ONLY to legacy units running software versions prior to 3.2 with PS-04. The 175 bar reading in site_survey_notes.docx is an unverified, uncalibrated field gauge observation on an unknown revision, subordinated under the FIELD_RECORD_LOW_TRUST hierarchy; it cannot override controlled specifications.
